prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Chinese woman — the personification of Beijing — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Beijing as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Beijing with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the walkway of the ancient crenellated wall on a mountain ridge north of her far-future city at night — the old stone kept exactly as it was, a watchtower ahead of her sending a pulse of vermilion light to the next ridge, the wall winding away over the dark mountains and the megacity glowing on the horizon
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a beacon-keeper look fitted to her body — a cropped high-collared smart-fabric jacket with a scalloped cloud-collar edge traced in yellow light, a fitted top, high-cut shorts, a slim exo-frame along her legs and tall sleek boots, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a slim beacon baton of white ceramic and chrome, a steady flame of vermilion light burning at its tip at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.
Scene note: she is the beacon keeper of the wall, striding along the walkway toward the next watchtower with her beacon baton held before her, ready to pass the light on

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
